name: Zombie Car VR: Crush & Survive
summary:
Take the wheel and enter a city overrun by the undead in Zombie Car VR: Crush & Survive, an immersive first-person VR zombie survival and car combat game built for Meta Quest.

Drive, dodge and crush your way through relentless zombie hordes. Normal zombies can be defeated only when you hit them with enough speed, so keep moving, choose your route and use your vehicle as your weapon. Every zombie attack damages your car, while unstoppable giant zombies join the chase and turn each run into an intense fight
